title: Single-cell parallel analysis of DNA damage and transcriptome reveals selective genome vulnerability
boundary: In-nucleus repair labeling with biotinylated nucleotides directs anti-biotin/protein-A-Tn5 damage-targeted tagmentation; shared split-pool barcodes jointly recover damage DNA and RNA. Distinct from bulk RADD pull-down or ordinary Paired-Tag chromatin targets.
evidence_scope: Published2025 identity/abstract and primary workflow overview checked via associated PMC12182908; author repository opening independently states targeted-tagmentation principle. No full recipe/supplement review.

title: Mapping single-cell diploid chromatin fiber architectures using DAF-seq
boundary: Accessible cytidines undergo direct dsDNA deamination, encoding protein footprints as copyable C-to-T changes; single-cell preparation couples this to PTA. Different product/amplification boundary from native-DNA methyltransferase footprinting, not merely another methylase or sequencing platform.
evidence_scope: PublishedDec2025 primary publisher/PubMed41339527 identity/abstract and author-owned DAF-seq guide opening checked. Bulk/targeted/single-cell branches are one discovery candidate; complete chemistry and source figures not reviewed.

title: Genome-wide analysis of 8-oxo-7,8-dihydro-2'-deoxyguanosine at single-nucleotide resolution unveils reduced occurrence of oxidative damage at G-quadruplex sites
boundary: Chemical biotin conjugation enlarges 8-oxoG into a polymerase-stalling substrate; stalled extension products receive a second adapter for damage-site sequencing. More than OG-seq fragment enrichment or substituting a damage antibody in Damage-seq.
evidence_scope: Published2021 primary identity/abstract and Fig1 workflow caption checked. Later repair-time-course application gkaf1330 is not a second candidate. No full methods/supplement review.

title: Genome-Wide Mapping of Oxidative DNA Damage via Engineering of 8-Oxoguanine DNA Glycosylase
boundary: Engineered hOGG1 K249Q retains OG-DNA through noncovalent trapping for enrichment; unlike queued NTHL1 DPC-Seq, this does not require lesion excision to an AP-site/reductively trapped covalent intermediate. Molecular binding-mode boundary, not simply another enzyme target.
evidence_scope: Published online2019/issue2020 primary ACS identity/abstract and embedded publishedSI contents (FigS3 mutant comparison/FigS4 noncovalent interaction) checked. Complete SI and enrichment recipe not read; unrelated plant ENTRAP-seq excluded.

title: Incorporation of a nucleoside analog maps genome repair sites in postmitotic human neurons
boundary: In-cell nonreplicative EdU incorporation labels repair synthesis, followed by DNA isolation/shearing, click-biotin capture and NGS. This measures physiological repair patches rather than in-vitro repair-labeling of extracted lesions; distinct from the CRISPR-screen homonym.
evidence_scope: Published2021 primary identity/abstract and Fig1 overview checked via publisher/associated PMC9179101. Concurrent SAR-seq10.1038/s41586-021-03468-5 is not proposed separately without a demonstrated preparative boundary. No full chemistry review.

title: Mapping the genetic landscape of DNA double-strand break repair
boundary: Integrated reporter keeps perturbation sgRNA and edited target on one restriction-defined fragment; NotI/HindIII selection and custom UMI-adapter ligation enable joint perturbation/outcome reads. Different molecular linkage/readout from ordinary guide-counting screens or neuronal EdU Repair-seq.
evidence_scope: Published2021 primary identity/summary and selected joint-fragment library/figure overview checked via associated PMC9074467. This is a discovery boundary check, not a complete source/recipe audit or screening-panel variant.

title: DNA break mapping reveals topoisomerase II activity genome-wide
boundary: Native SSB nick translation introduces digoxigenin with chain terminators; antibody capture follows shearing. Distinct from TdT tailing or lesion-excision gap-fill routes.
evidence_scope: Published2014 identity/abstract plus2018 primary followup chapter10.1007/978-1-4939-7306-4_13 overview checked. Original PMC access gated; no retry or full version-equivalence claim. Separate SSB route within the same defining paper.

title: DNA break mapping reveals topoisomerase II activity genome-wide
boundary: TdT biotinylated tailing marks native DSB ends before shearing/capture; S1 removes recovered tails. Distinct from SSB nick translation and BLESS end-adapter ligation.
evidence_scope: Published2014 identity/abstract plus2018 primary followup overview checked. Original PMC access gated; no retry or complete recipe equivalence claim. Same DOI as SSB-Seq, explicitly different molecular preparation, not another paper count.
